title: Run Manifest
description: Complete provenance record for one benchmark run. Written before measurement begins; timing-condition fields are finalized at run end. Must contain no secrets, account identifiers, or instance identifiers. Schema version 2.x: mock execution requires the mock engine, forbids GPU host fields, the container digest, and the model block, and uses the truthful not-applicable comparison classification; gpu execution requires a non-mock engine, the GPU host fields, the container digest, and the model block.

execution_mode.description: How the run executed: 'gpu' for a genuine GPU serving endpoint, 'mock' for the offline deterministic mock client (Phase 2). Mock runs must not fabricate GPU host details, and this field — not is_synthetic_example — is the execution-mode indicator.

run_id.description: Unique, non-sensitive identifier for this run (e.g. UUID).

is_synthetic_example.description: True only for synthetic example files committed to the repository. Genuine runs must set false; genuine manifests live outside the Git working tree and must never be committed.

commit.description: Full Git commit SHA of the benchmark code used.

repository.description: Repository URL for the benchmark code.

dirty.description: True if the working tree had uncommitted changes (invalidates the run).

model.description: The served model. Required for gpu execution; FORBIDDEN for mock execution — the mock client serves no model, and no workload/catalog digest may be misrepresented as a model artifact hash (the catalog digest lives in workload.catalog_digest).

artifact.description: Model artifact identifier (e.g. Hugging Face repo id).

revision.description: Artifact repository revision (commit) the weights were fetched at.

artifact_hash.description: Aggregate content hash of the model files (algorithm:hex). Digest length is algorithm-specific: sha256 and blake3 require exactly 64 hex characters; sha512 requires exactly 128.

precision.description: Numerical precision / quantization of the served weights.

license.description: License identifier of the model artifact (e.g. OpenMDW-1.1).

engine.description: Serving path. 'mock' is the offline deterministic mock client (execution_mode must be 'mock'; gpu execution requires a non-mock engine).

engine_version.description: Exact serving-engine version (and commit for non-release builds).

container_digest.description: Immutable container image digest (repo@sha256:...). Required for gpu execution; forbidden for mock execution (no container is involved).

environment_overrides.description: Non-secret environment variables affecting engine behavior (e.g. backend selections).

host.description: Host description. GPU fields (gpu_model, gpu_count, gpu_memory_gb, driver_version, cuda_version) are required when execution_mode is 'gpu' and FORBIDDEN when execution_mode is 'mock' — mock runs must not fabricate GPU values.

gpu_model.description: e.g. NVIDIA RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell Server Edition

cpu_model.description: Host CPU model as reported by the instance.

network_description.description: Advertised network tier/bandwidth of the purchasable configuration (no addresses or interface identifiers).

instance_type.description: Purchasable instance type / plan name (NOT an instance identifier).

region.description: Provider region name (zone allowed where applicable).

comparison_mode.description: Which comparison mode this run belongs to. Modes are never mixed in analysis. Mock execution must use 'not-applicable' (there is no serving resource to classify); gpu execution must use a real mode.

resource_limits.description: Container resource caps applied in controlled-resource mode: the JOINT total across the serving and benchmark workload (see methodology). Required whenever comparison_mode is controlled-resource.

list_price_usd_per_hour.description: On-demand list price basis used for cost measures.

price_source_date.description: Date the list price was sourced.

seed.description: Seed used, or null if the engine does not support seeding.

reasoning_mode.description: Chat-template reasoning/thinking toggle if the model supports one.

version.description: Workload/scenario fixture version (Git commit or semver).

catalog_digest.description: Content-address of the exact scenario catalog used (canonical JSON, SHA-256). This is a WORKLOAD digest — it is never a model artifact hash.

tasks_per_repetition.description: Task instances per measured repetition (measurement default 200, balanced across incident templates; decision D-0010).

scenario_count.description: Number of distinct incident templates drawn from.

warmup_description.description: Warm-up procedure applied before measurement (warm-up observations are retained separately, labeled, and excluded from measured summaries).

repetition_index.description: 1-based index of this repetition within the cell.

repetitions_planned.description: Planned repetitions for the cell (5 per the measurement contract).

notes.description: Any other timing-relevant conditions (must contain no sensitive metadata).
